name: Dealport
description: Cited US private company, commercial building, 50-state parcel, and verified owner intelligence for agents.
notes: Uses Dealport's official hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server (com.dealport/dealport on the Official MCP Registry, 47 tools across 28M+ cited US private company Records, commercial buildings, 50-state parcels, LLC officer unmasking, public filings, Projects, Playbooks, and double-opt-in introductions through Avery, Dealport's AI outreach specialist who always discloses she is an AI). Supports OAuth 2.1 PKCE, optional Bearer API key (keyless preview_companies costs $0.00; API Pro accounts start with a $5.00 free balance on pay-as-you-go), and a local npx dealport mcp serve stdio fallback.
installHint: Prefer OAuth or the hosted Streamable HTTP API-key option. Leave the API key blank to test $0.00 preview_companies market sizing, or create a dp_live_... workspace key at https://app.dealport.com/connect?tab=keys ($5.00 free starting balance, pay as you go).

auth.credentialHelp: Create a workspace API key (`dp_live_...`) under [Dealport Connect > API Keys](https://app.dealport.com/connect?tab=keys) ($5.00 free starting balance, pay as you go), or leave blank for keyless $0.00 preview_companies calls. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
